types.name: Game
types.signature: public abstract class Game : TypeOObject, IHasContext
types.summary: Represents the base class for a game, providing core functionality for managing game logic, rendering, content loading, and scenes.
types.remarks:
The Core.Game class serves as the foundation for creating games. It provides
essential components such as drawable and logic managers, a content loader, and a scene list. Derived classes
must implement the Game.Update and Game.Draw methods to define the game's update and
rendering behavior. The game operates within a Game.Context, which manages the overall state and
lifecycle of the game. The Game.Exit method can be used to terminate the game gracefully.

properly initialized and registered with the application context.

members.remarks:
This method delegates the exit operation to the underlying context. Ensure that any
necessary cleanup is performed before calling this method.

types.name: Scene
types.signature: public abstract class Scene : TypeOObject, IHasEntities, IHasEntities<Drawable>, IHasContext
types.summary:
Represents an abstract base class for a scene in a game or application, providing core functionality for
managing entities, drawing, updating, and transitioning between scenes.
types.remarks:
A scene serves as a container for game logic, drawable objects, and other resources required
to represent a specific state or screen in the application. It provides mechanisms for updating game logic,
rendering visuals, and handling transitions between scenes.  Derived classes must implement the
Scene.Update and Scene.Draw methods to define the scene's behavior and rendering logic.
Additionally, the Scene.OnEnter and Scene.OnExit methods must be implemented to
handle transitions between scenes.

types.summary: Interface for restoring missing components, files, and configurations in a TypeD project.

members.name: Restore
members.summary: Restores missing components, files, and configurations for the specified project.
members.remarks:
This method ensures that all required components, such as entities, scenes, and
drawables, are present in the project. It also restores missing `.component` files, `Program.cs`, and
other essential files. If necessary, it creates default components like the game class and the start scene.
Additionally, it updates the project structure and rebuilds the component tree if changes are made. The
method performs the following actions:

Restores missing `.component` files for types derived from Entities.Entity, Core.Scene, or Drawables.Drawable.

Ensures that `Program.cs` exists in the project directory.

Checks for missing `.cs` files for components and generates them if necessary.

Creates the game class and start scene if they are missing.

Rebuilds the component tree if updates are made to the project structure.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The project to restore. Cannot be null.
